family.name: Cultists of the Cracked Bell
family.lore: They heard the bell crack and took the sound for an answer. They have been ringing back ever since.

monsters.name: Knell Slinger
monsters.desc: It slings clappers torn out of village bells, each one wrapped in a scrap of prayer.
monsters.answer: Close the distance or break its line of sight. It gives ground only once in a while.

monsters.name: Toller of the Cracked Bell
monsters.desc: It carries a hand-bell with a split lip and rings it for every name it no longer remembers.
monsters.answer: The knell falls on a cross of tiles: one diagonal step takes you out of it.

monsters.name: Bell Deacon
monsters.desc: It plants its pole-bell in the earth and calls the parish to service. The parish comes up.
monsters.answer: Reach it before the ground opens, or spend the corpses yourself before it can.

monsters.name: Cracked Chorister
monsters.desc: Its mask is fixed open on a single note. While it sings, the wounded around it close up.
monsters.answer: Break the hymn with a hard blow or a stun, or step behind something it cannot see past.
